page.notes: The scan is cut off at the lower part of the page; the lines shown here end where the image ends. Several entries in the left and middle columns are faint or smudged, and the figures are uncertain where marked by the low resolution; the entries that could not be read reliably are not given. Faint text at the far left edge belongs to the neighbouring page and is not transcribed. The scan is very small and blurred; the right-hand column from about the middle down is largely illegible and its page numbers are uncertain. Lines marked with ellipses are only partly readable and were not reconstructed. Entries with Greek or Hebrew words may be incomplete. Index columns are heavily worn and blotted; many entries are partly illegible and the readings above are approximate. No page number or running head is legible.
